description: Code-behind for ShowAns.aspx page; handles displaying and submitting answers for theory questions in an online exam system, including database interactions and session management.

classes.name: ShowAns
classes.description: Code-behind class for ShowAns.aspx, managing answer display and submission.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles page load event; retrieves answers from database and populates UI controls based on session data.

methods.name: submitB_Click
methods.description: Calculates total marks, updates database with submitted marks, removes student from queue, and redirects to AdminCourseQueue.aspx.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out user and redirects to LoginPage.aspx.
